title: Structured logs: JSON lines, request-scoped correlation, declared levels
asA: on-call engineer diagnosing a production incident
iWant: machine-parseable logs where every request-scoped line carries its correlation ids
soThat: I can reconstruct any request's story with one query instead of reading prose

acceptanceCriteria.description: Every log line is a single JSON object with at minimum timestamp, level, message, and service name; no multi-line or prose-format lines are emitted.
acceptanceCriteria.given: log output under normal and error traffic
acceptanceCriteria.when: each line is parsed as JSON
acceptanceCriteria.then: every line parses and carries the four base fields

acceptanceCriteria.description: Every request-scoped log line carries the request id and, when tracing is active, the trace id.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a request producing multiple log lines
acceptanceCriteria.when: the lines are filtered by the request id
acceptanceCriteria.then: every line the request produced appears, each also carrying the trace id when a trace context existed

acceptanceCriteria.description: The declared log level per auth class is honoured: request completion lines are emitted at the class's declared level, and level configuration changes take effect without a code change.
acceptanceCriteria.then: completion lines appear at the declared level per class

acceptanceCriteria.description: Request completion lines carry method, path template, status, duration, and auth class, so traffic questions are answerable from logs alone.
acceptanceCriteria.then: method, path template, status, duration, and auth class are present

acceptanceCriteria.description: Log output honours the redaction rules of rest-REQ-016: no secrets and no unredacted PII at any level, verified against a request deliberately carrying both.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a request carrying a bearer token and personal data
acceptanceCriteria.when: all log output for that request is scanned
acceptanceCriteria.then: the token never appears and personal data appears only in redacted form
